title: Warden Killer
description: Adds an OP sword that strikes lightning and has a custom easy survival recipe.
body: This is the official Warden Killer mod for Minecraft. It introduces an incredibly powerful, custom-designed sword built to defeat any monster. The Warden Killer weapon inflicts an impressive 1000 base damage per hit, eliminates attack cooldowns with maximum speed, and triggers a real lightning strike directly on top of your target with every attack. Players can easily craft this weapon in survival mode using a simple recipe made of traditional oak wood planks and basic sticks.
